frequency_question: What proportion of complex bilateral water treaty negotiations initiated or renewed within a 36-month window successfully complete all administrative, technical, and ministerial steps to sign a successor agreement before expiration?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral water-sharing, basin management, or boundary water treaties that required successor frameworks upon expiration. Excludes unilateral declarations, non-binding memorandums on unrelated topics, and internal water management policies.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and subsequent peripheral adjustments
1996 Ganga Water Treaty initial negotiation and signing process
Mahakali Treaty between India and Nepal
Treaty on Sharing of Teesta Water (drafted but stalled)

coverage_note: 4 major bilateral water treaty processes involving the primary regional actor over the specified window; believed complete for major binding river basin treaties.
known_gaps: Minor technical committee renewals and localized sub-basin arrangements excluded due to lack of formalized standalone treaties.
validity_reason: Bilateral hydro-diplomacy protocols and administrative review timelines remain stable across decades unless major structural shifts in governance occur.
